# T03 — Unit tests for CSV parsing and the data model

## Goal
Write Node built-in test-runner tests (`node:test` + `node:assert/strict`) for `assets/js/csv.js` and `assets/js/model.js`.

## Owns
- `tests/csv.test.js`
- `tests/model.test.js`
- `tests/fixtures/*` (optional small CSV fixtures)

## Read-only context (do NOT edit)
- `assets/js/csv.js`, `assets/js/model.js`, `assets/js/config.js`
- `tests/setup.js` — MUST be imported first in each test file: `import './setup.js';` (it sets `globalThis.Papa`). Import the modules under test AFTER it, e.g. `const { parseCsv } = await import('../assets/js/csv.js');` (top-level await is fine; the repo's package.json has `"type": "module"`).
- `data/wishlist.csv` — real 13-row GiftList export (has a UTF-8 BOM).
- `package.json` — `npm test` runs `node --test tests/`.

Note: `tests/setup.js` will also be picked up by `node --test tests/` as a test file; that is fine (it has no tests).

## Tests to write (match these behaviours exactly; read the source to confirm)
csv.test.js:
1. Real file: `parseCsv(readFileSync('data/wishlist.csv','utf8'))` → 13 rows, headers exactly `['title','url','price','currency','quantity','notes','most_wanted','tags','image_url','gift_id']` (BOM stripped), no errors.
2. Quoted commas: row with title `"12 Ct, Multicolor Sharpies (Permanent)"` parses as one field.
3. Embedded newline inside quotes and `""` escaped quotes parse correctly.
4. Unicode (e.g. `isn’t`, `™`) preserved.
5. Headers are trimmed + lower-cased (`" Title "` → `title`).
6. `toCsv` round-trip: rows with commas, quotes, newlines → `parseCsv(toCsv(rows, cols))` returns equal rows.

model.test.js:
1. `parseBool`: TRUE/true/yes/1 → true; FALSE/false/''/undefined → false.
2. `safeHttpUrl`: https/http OK; `javascript:alert(1)`, `ftp://x`, `not a url`, '' → null.
3. `parsePrice`: '179.99' → 179.99; '' → null; 'abc' → NaN; '1,299.00' → 1299.
4. `parseQuantity`: '2' → 2; '' / '0' / '-1' / 'x' → 1.
5. `parseTags`: `"APPLE, BESTBUY, AMAZON, apple"` → `['APPLE','BESTBUY','AMAZON']`; '' → [].
6. `imageCandidates` with config objects passed explicitly (`{imagesDir:'images/wishlist', imageBaseUrl:'', localImageExtensions:['webp','jpg','png']}`): absolute https URL comes first; relative `media/x.webp` with empty base → only local candidates; with `imageBaseUrl:'https://cdn.example.com/'` → first is `https://cdn.example.com/media/x.webp`; local candidates are `images/wishlist/<id>.webp|jpg|png`.
7. `isUnresolvedImage`: relative + no base → true; absolute → false; '' → false; with base → false.
8. `normalizeItem` on the real file's row 3 (Airpods Max 2): mostWanted true, price null, priceText '', tags 4 items, reason text preserved exactly, description ''.
9. `buildWishlist` on the real file: 13 items, missingColumns [], unknownColumns []; warnings include one for "Grant Theft Auto VI" having no purchase URL; 13 unresolved-image warnings.
10. `buildWishlist` edge cases: row missing title → skipped with error; duplicate gift_id → second skipped with error; missing gift_id column → `missingColumns` contains 'gift_id'; invalid URL → warning and `item.url === null`; unknown column `foo` → in unknownColumns.
11. Adding a row: real CSV text + one appended row → 14 items (list is not fixed-size).
12. `canonicalize`: keeps an extra column `foo` after the canonical columns; most_wanted normalized to 'TRUE'/'FALSE'; values for notes/tags/gift_id unchanged.
13. `buildPurchases`: parses ints, ignores blank gift_id, archived parsed as bool, negatives clamp to 0.
14. `computeStatus`: qty1 no record → available/'Available'; qty1 record purchased 1 → purchased; qty2 purchased 1 → partial, label '1 of 2 purchased', remaining 1; local marks add on top but cap at requested; shared over requested caps; `csvPurchased: true` → purchased.

## Acceptance
`cd /home/user/cadensPGL && npm test` passes. If a test fails because the SOURCE behaves differently from this spec, do not change the source and do not weaken the test silently: keep the test matching the spec, mark it with `{ todo: 'source differs: <detail>' }`, and list it in your report.

## Out of scope
Any file outside Owns.

## Report
Write `.claude/delegation/pgl/reports/T03.md`: status, files, `npm test` output summary, any spec/source mismatches.
